title: Radar Panoptic Transformer: Semantic-Guided Mask Queries for Dynamic Scene Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.20203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automotive radar provides long-range sensing and direct Doppler velocity measurements, but its sparse and non-uniformly sampled point clouds pose significant challenges for panoptic segmentation. Dynamic objects often yield only a few detections amid a dominant static background, providing limiting the geometric cues for separating object instances. We propose \emph{Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT)}, an end-to-end point-based network that incorporates radar-adaptive feature extraction with semantic-guided mask prediction. Its backbone aggregates pose-aligned temporal context through grouped vector attention and learns per-point neighborhood radii conditioned on range, azimuth, and radar cross section (RCS). Point-wise semantic predictions initialize queries at likely foreground detections and guide masked cross-attention through query-point class agreement, producing instance masks without geometric clustering. translated_title: 雷达全景Transformer：面向动态场景理解的语义引导掩码查询
translated_abstract: 汽车雷达能够提供远距离感知和直接的多普勒速度测量，但其稀疏且非均匀采样的点云为全景分割带来了重大挑战。动态目标往往在占主导地位的静态背景中仅产生少量检测点，这限制了用于分离目标实例的几何线索。我们提出了雷达全景Transformer（RPT），这是一种端到端的基于点的网络，将雷达自适应特征提取与语义引导的掩码预测相结合。其骨干网络通过分组向量注意力聚合姿态对齐的时序上下文，并根据距离、方位角和雷达散射截面（RCS）学习每个点的邻域半径。逐点语义预测在可能的前景检测处初始化查询，并通过查询与点之间的类别一致性引导掩码交叉注意力，从而在无需几何聚类的情况下生成实例掩码。辅助的RCS一致性……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了雷达全景Transformer（RPT），通过语义引导的掩码查询和雷达自适应特征提取，在稀疏雷达点云上实现无需几何聚类的端到端全景分割，从而更好地理解动态场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT), an end-to-end network that achieves panoptic segmentation on sparse radar point clouds without geometric clustering by combining radar-adaptive feature extraction with semantic-guided mask queries for dynamic scene understanding.
